chunks: And it was narrated: “That the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, performed wudu (ablution), then wiped over his sandals.
So al-Mughīrah said to him, ‘Did you forget, O Messenger of Allah?’
He said, ‘Rather, you have forgotten; this is how my Lord commanded me.’”

key_terms.الْمُغِيرَةُ: al-Mughīrah, the person who addressed the Prophet

ai.seo_question: What did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله say when al-Mughīrah questioned his wiping over his sandals in wudu (ablution)?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله performed wudu (ablution) and wiped over his sandals, then corrected al-Mughīrah when he questioned the act. The report presents the Prophet’s practice as being in accordance with divine command and is cited in the context of ritual purity and the description of his wudu (ablution).

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.75 - It was narrated that the Messenger of Allah (sw) performed wudu and then wiped over his sandals.
Al-Mughirah said to him: "Did you forget, O’ Messenger of Allah (sw)?"
He (sw) replied: "No, rather it is you who has forgotten. This is how my Lord (azj) commanded me."
